headline: Loras finishes unbeaten in conference play
dek: Loras closed its overall season at thirteen wins, one draw, and three defeats, scoring 50 goals across all matches while conceding fourteen. Central (Iowa) matched that win total and outscored every conference rival, yet finished behind Loras and Dubuque in the standings.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in the conference splits into a sharp top tier and a crowded lower pack: Central (Iowa) produced 57 goals across all matches, outscoring Wartburg, Nebraska Wesleyan, Buena Vista, and Coe combined.

wire.line: Conference programs posted 29 wins, six draws, and twenty losses outside the league, scoring 94 goals and conceding 85.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Central (Iowa) spread its attack across at least sixteen different scorers over the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Central (Iowa) forward Olivia DeVos scored seventeen goals and added seven assists on 52 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dubuque goalkeeper Samantha Jurgens recorded 83 saves while conceding twenty goals across the season, and kept nine shutouts.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Buena Vista conceded 64 goals across all matches while scoring thirteen, finishing with two wins, one draw, and twelve losses.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three August matches remain past their scheduled dates with no published result: Dubuque at Knox, Central (Iowa) against North Iowa Area CC, and Dubuque against Rockford Raptors.

last_match.line: The defeat closed the season for the unbeaten regular-season conference champion.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
